title: Faux amis: actuellement, éventuellement, une librairie
summary: French words that look English but mean something else, with the right English and the French for the English word: actuellement, éventuellement, une librairie, sensible, passer un examen…
focus: Recognising the common faux amis and choosing the French word you really need
content:
## Adverbs and verbs that fool you

| French | really means | for the English word, say |
|---|---|---|
| **actuellement** | currently | actually → **en fait** |
| **éventuellement** | possibly, if need be | eventually → **finalement** |
| **assister à** | to attend | to assist → **aider** |
| **attendre** | to wait (for) | to attend → **assister à** |
| **rester** | to stay | to rest → **se reposer** |
| **prétendre** | to claim | to pretend → **faire semblant** |
| **demander** | to ask | to demand → **exiger** |

- **Actuellement, elle vit à Rome.** (She currently lives in Rome.)
- **Il prétend qu'il a raison.** (He claims he's right.)

## Nouns and adjectives that fool you

| French | really means | for the English word, say |
|---|---|---|
| **une librairie** | a bookshop | library → **une bibliothèque** |
| **sensible** | sensitive | sensible → **raisonnable** |
| **un coin** | a corner | coin → **une pièce** |
| **une location** | a rental | location → **un lieu**, **un emplacement** |
| **large** | wide | large → **grand** |
| **la monnaie** | change, currency | money → **l'argent** |
| **le raisin** | grapes | raisins → **les raisins secs** |
| **une veste** | a jacket | vest → **un maillot de corps** (UK), **un gilet** (US) |

## Exams, and a safe habit

**Passer un examen** means to *take* or *sit* it, whatever the result. To pass it is **réussir un examen** (or **être reçu**); to fail it is **rater** or **échouer à un examen**.

- **Je passe le bac en juin.** (I'm sitting the baccalauréat in June.)
- **Elle a réussi son permis du premier coup.** (She passed her driving test first time.)

When a French word looks just like an English one, stop and ask whether the meaning really fits the sentence. Many words are true friends (**une table**, **important**), but the ones above catch even advanced learners.

vocabulary.example: Actuellement, je travaille à Lyon.
vocabulary.example_meaning: I'm currently working in Lyon.

vocabulary.example: En fait, je ne suis pas d'accord.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Actually, I don't agree.

vocabulary.example: On pourrait éventuellement partir plus tôt.
vocabulary.example_meaning: We could possibly leave earlier.

vocabulary.example: Finalement, on est restés à la maison.
vocabulary.example_meaning: In the end, we stayed at home.

vocabulary.example: J'ai acheté ce roman à la librairie du quartier.
vocabulary.example_meaning: I bought this novel at the local bookshop.

vocabulary.example: On peut emprunter des livres à la bibliothèque.
vocabulary.example_meaning: You can borrow books at the library.

vocabulary.example: Ma peau est très sensible au soleil.
vocabulary.example_meaning: My skin is very sensitive to the sun.

vocabulary.example: Rentre avant minuit, c'est plus raisonnable.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Come home before midnight, it's more sensible.

vocabulary.example: Deux cents personnes ont assisté à la réunion.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Two hundred people attended the meeting.

vocabulary.example: Je reste chez moi ce soir.
vocabulary.example_meaning: I'm staying at home tonight.

vocabulary.example: Il prétend qu'il a tout compris.
vocabulary.example_meaning: He claims he understood everything.

vocabulary.example: Désolé, je n'ai pas de monnaie.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Sorry, I haven't got any change.

vocabulary.example: La location de la voiture coûte cher.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The car hire is expensive.

vocabulary.meaning: to take, to sit an exam (not 'to pass')
vocabulary.example: Je passe mon examen de conduite demain.
vocabulary.example_meaning: I'm taking my driving test tomorrow.

quiz.prompt: Your French colleague says: 'Actuellement, je travaille de chez moi.' What does she mean?
options: At the moment, I work from home.
quiz.correct_answer: At the moment, I work from home.
quiz.explanation: Actuellement means currently, at the moment. Actually is en fait.

quiz.prompt: Tu veux lire ce livre sans l'acheter ? Emprunte-le à la ___ municipale.
quiz.explanation: You borrow books at la bibliothèque (library). La librairie is a bookshop, where you buy them.
hints: Not the bookshop: the place that lends books.

quiz.prompt: How do you tell a French friend 'I passed my exam'?
quiz.explanation: To pass is réussir. J'ai passé mon examen only says you sat it, not that you passed.
hints: Passer un examen = to take it.

quiz.prompt: 'Mon frère est très sensible' means 'My brother is very sensible'.
quiz.explanation: Sensible means sensitive. A sensible person is raisonnable.
hints: Sensible in French is about feelings.

quiz.prompt: ___, je ne suis pas d'accord avec toi. (Actually,)
quiz.explanation: Actually (in fact) is en fait. Actuellement would mean at the moment.
Eventually (in the end) is finalement. Éventuellement means possibly, if need be.

quiz.prompt: Je suis fatigué, j'ai besoin de me ___. (to rest)
quiz.explanation: To rest is se reposer. Rester means to stay.

quiz.prompt: 'J'ai assisté à la conférence' means 'I attended the conference'.
quiz.explanation: Assister à means to attend. To assist (help) someone is aider quelqu'un.

quiz.prompt: You hand the baker a fifty-euro note for a baguette. She asks: 'Vous n'avez pas de ___ ?' (smaller coins)
quiz.explanation: La monnaie is change, small coins. Un coin is a corner, and le change is currency exchange.
hints: Not money in general: the coins you get back.

conversations.title: The day before the exam
conversations.scenario: Emma, an exchange student, chats with her French host Julien the evening before her French exam.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Julien, demain je passe mon examen de français !
lines.meaning: Julien, tomorrow I'm sitting my French exam!
lines.note: passer = to take, not to pass

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Bon courage ! J'espère que tu vas le réussir.
lines.meaning: Good luck! I hope you pass it.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Merci. En fait, je suis un peu stressée.
lines.meaning: Thanks. Actually, I'm a bit stressed.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: C'est normal. Tu as révisé où aujourd'hui ?
lines.meaning: That's normal. Where did you revise today?

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: À la librairie, comme tous les jours.
lines.meaning: At the bookshop, like every day.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: À la librairie ? Tu veux dire à la bibliothèque, non ?
lines.meaning: At the bookshop? You mean at the library, don't you?

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Oups, oui ! Et après, j'ai assisté à un cours de grammaire.
lines.meaning: Oops, yes! And afterwards I attended a grammar class.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Très bien. Et ce soir, tu restes à la maison ?
lines.meaning: Very good. And tonight, are you staying at home?

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Oui, je reste ici et je relis mes notes.
lines.meaning: Yes, I'm staying here and going over my notes.

lines.speaker: b
lines.meaning: Get some rest too, it's more sensible.
lines.note: se reposer = to rest; raisonnable = sensible

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Tu as raison. Finalement, je vais me coucher tôt.
lines.meaning: You're right. In the end, I'll go to bed early.

listening.text: La librairie ferme à sept heures.
listening.meaning: The bookshop closes at seven.

listening.text: Actuellement, mon frère vit au Canada.
listening.meaning: My brother currently lives in Canada.

listening.text: Range ta veste dans le placard.
listening.meaning: Put your jacket away in the cupboard.
listening.note: New word: la veste = the jacket.

listening.text: Elle a réussi son examen du premier coup.
listening.meaning: She passed her exam first time.
listening.note: Réussir is to pass; passer is to take.

listening.text: Cette rue est large et très calme.
listening.meaning: This street is wide and very quiet.

listening.text: Je vais acheter du raisin au marché.
listening.meaning: I'm going to buy some grapes at the market.

listening.text: Il fait semblant de dormir quand sa mère l'appelle.
listening.meaning: He pretends to be asleep when his mother calls him.
listening.note: New word: faire semblant = to pretend.

listening.text: Nous avons assisté à un très beau concert dans la vieille église.
listening.meaning: We attended a lovely concert in the old church.

guide.tip: Before you use an English-looking French word, ask whether a French speaker would really say it here. If in doubt, look it up in both directions.

concept.title: Half-false friends
concept.markdown: Some words are only half false. **Une expérience** is both an experience and a scientific experiment. **Un examen** is an exam but also a medical examination. **Une figure** is a figure in maths, yet in everyday speech **la figure** is the face: **lave-toi la figure** (wash your face).

bites.title: Actuellement ≠ actually
bites.rule: Actuellement = at the moment; actually = en fait. Éventuellement = possibly; eventually = finalement.

bites.title: Bookshop or library?
bites.rule: Une librairie sells books; une bibliothèque lends them.
bites.example: J'emprunte des livres à la bibliothèque.
bites.example_meaning: I borrow books from the library.

bites.title: Passer ≠ pass
bites.rule: Passer un examen = to take it. To pass is réussir; to fail is rater or échouer à.
bites.example: J'ai passé l'examen lundi et je l'ai réussi.
bites.example_meaning: I took the exam on Monday and passed it.

bites.title: Sensible, large, monnaie
bites.rule: Sensible = sensitive, large = wide, la monnaie = change. For sensible say raisonnable, for large grand, for money l'argent.
bites.example: Tu as de la monnaie pour le parking ?
bites.example_meaning: Have you got change for the car park?

sorts.title: En fait, finalement or actuellement?

items.text: At the moment, she's in Paris.

sorts.why: En fait = actually, in fact; finalement = eventually, in the end; actuellement = currently, at the moment.

sorts.title: Librairie or bibliothèque?

items.text: rendre les livres dans trois semaines

sorts.why: In a librairie you buy books from a libraire; in a bibliothèque you borrow them with a reader's card.

spots.sentence: Mon fils est très sensible : il économise tout son argent.
spots.why: Sensible means sensitive; a careful, sensible person is raisonnable.

spots.sentence: Je cherche un roman à emprunter à la librairie.
spots.why: You borrow books at the bibliothèque; a librairie sells them.

spots.sentence: Actuellement, je ne suis pas d'accord : c'est faux.
spots.why: Actually, in fact, is en fait; actuellement means at the moment.

spots.sentence: Éventuellement, après trois heures de marche, nous sommes arrivés au sommet.
spots.why: Eventually, in the end, is finalement; éventuellement means possibly.

spots.sentence: Je peux assister ma voisine à porter ses courses ?
spots.why: To help someone is aider; assister à means to attend.

spots.sentence: J'ai trouvé trois coins de deux euros par terre.
spots.why: Coins are des pièces; un coin is a corner.

realm.content:
## Les faux amis à Eldmark

A young elf gets it all wrong in Highgate: **la librairie** sells spellbooks, but the guild lends scrolls at **la bibliothèque**. **Actuellement**, the paladin **reste** at the taverne du Dragon Vert (he stays, he doesn't rest), and the orc **prétend** he beat a dragon: he claims it.

vocabulary.example: La librairie de Highgate vend des livres de sorts.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The Highgate bookshop sells spellbooks.

vocabulary.example: Séla emprunte un parchemin à la bibliothèque de la guilde.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Séla borrows a scroll from the guild library.

vocabulary.example: Actuellement, Borin est à Deepanvil.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Borin is currently in Deepanvil.

vocabulary.example: Le paladin reste à la taverne du Dragon Vert ce soir.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The paladin is staying at the Green Dragon tavern tonight.

vocabulary.example: L'orc prétend qu'il a vaincu un dragon.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The orc claims he defeated a dragon.

vocabulary.example: Toute la guilde assiste à la fête du roi.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The whole guild attends the king's feast.

vocabulary.example: Les elfes sont sensibles au froid de Frostmarch.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Elves are sensitive to the cold of Frostmarch.

vocabulary.example: La mage ouvre son livre de sorts.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The mage opens her spellbook.

vocabulary.example: La guilde se réunit à la taverne.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The guild meets at the tavern.

vocabulary.example: Ce parchemin est très ancien.
vocabulary.example_meaning: This scroll is very old.

bites.title: La mage à la librairie
bites.rule: In Highgate you buy books at la librairie and borrow scrolls at la bibliothèque. Actuellement = right now, not actually.
bites.example: Actuellement, Nym est dans la Forêt Ombreuse.
bites.example_meaning: Nym is currently in the Shadow Forest.

listening.text: La bibliothèque de la guilde est immense.
listening.meaning: The guild library is huge.

listening.text: Borin reste à Deepanvil cet hiver.
listening.meaning: Borin is staying in Deepanvil this winter.

listening.text: Le nain prétend qu'il est le plus fort.
listening.meaning: The dwarf claims he's the strongest.

listening.text: Actuellement, la mage étudie un sort.
listening.meaning: The mage is currently studying a spell.

listening.text: Nym a assisté au tournoi de Highgate.
listening.meaning: Nym attended the Highgate tournament.
listening.note: New word: le tournoi = the tournament.

builds.meaning: Séla is going to the library.

spots.sentence: Le mage achète un livre de sorts à la bibliothèque.
spots.why: You buy books at the librairie; the bibliothèque lends them.

spots.sentence: Éventuellement, après dix jours de marche, la guilde est arrivée à Frostmarch.
spots.why: In the end is finalement; éventuellement means possibly.

sorts.title: Rester or se reposer on the quest?

items.text: Borin ___ trois jours à la taverne.
Après la bataille, Nym a besoin de ___.
Le paladin ___ à Highgate cet hiver.
La mage est épuisée, elle va ___.
Les elfes ___ dans la forêt jusqu'au printemps.

sorts.why: Rester is to stay somewhere; to rest after effort is se reposer.

quiz.prompt: Séla wants to borrow a scroll for free. Where does she go in Highgate?
options: à la bibliothèque de la guilde
à la librairie de la guilde
à la location de la guilde
quiz.correct_answer: à la bibliothèque de la guilde
quiz.explanation: A bibliothèque lends books and scrolls. A librairie sells them, and une location is a rental.

quiz.prompt: 'L'orc prétend qu'il a vaincu un dragon' means the orc is pretending, acting as if he had defeated one.
quiz.explanation: Prétendre means to claim: the orc says he did it. To pretend, act as if, is faire semblant.

meadowbrook.content:
## Les faux amis à Meadowbrook

At the market, Rosa asks: **vous avez de la monnaie ?** (change, not money). Léo sells **du raisin** (grapes, not raisins), and Nora **reste** at the farm all winter. **Actuellement**, everyone is getting ready for la fête des récoltes.

vocabulary.example: Rosa n'a pas de monnaie sur vingt euros.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Rosa hasn't got change for twenty euros.

vocabulary.example: Nora reste à la ferme tout l'hiver.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Nora stays on the farm all winter.

vocabulary.example: Actuellement, les vaches sont dans le pré.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The cows are in the meadow at the moment.

vocabulary.example: La location du tracteur coûte cher.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Hiring the tractor is expensive.

vocabulary.example: Les fraises sont sensibles au froid.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Strawberries are sensitive to the cold.

vocabulary.example: Finalement, il a fait beau pour la fête.
vocabulary.example_meaning: In the end, the weather was fine for the festival.

vocabulary.example: Léo achète un livre sur la pêche à la librairie.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Léo buys a book about fishing at the bookshop.

vocabulary.example: Le raisin est mûr en septembre.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The grapes are ripe in September.

vocabulary.example: Les moutons mangent dans le pré.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The sheep graze in the meadow.

vocabulary.example: Le tracteur de Nora est tout neuf.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Nora's tractor is brand new.

bites.title: Au marché de Meadowbrook
bites.rule: La monnaie = change, l'argent = money, le raisin = grapes (raisins are raisins secs).
bites.example: Je voudrais un kilo de raisin, s'il vous plaît.
bites.example_meaning: I'd like a kilo of grapes, please.

listening.text: Rosa rend la monnaie à Léo.
listening.meaning: Rosa gives Léo his change.

listening.text: Ce raisin vient de la ferme.
listening.meaning: These grapes come from the farm.

listening.text: Les poules restent dans le poulailler.
listening.meaning: The hens stay in the henhouse.
listening.note: New word: le poulailler = the henhouse.

listening.text: Actuellement, Nora plante des fraises.
listening.meaning: Nora is planting strawberries at the moment.

listening.text: La location de la grange est gratuite.
listening.meaning: Renting the barn is free.
listening.note: New word: la grange = the barn.

builds.text: Léo vend du raisin au marché.
builds.meaning: Léo sells grapes at the market.

spots.sentence: Nora est très sensible : elle met son argent de côté.
spots.why: Saving money is being raisonnable; sensible means sensitive.

spots.sentence: Léo emprunte un livre sur la pêche à la librairie.
spots.why: You borrow at the bibliothèque; the librairie sells books.

sorts.title: Monnaie or argent at the market?

items.text: Vous avez de la ___ sur dix euros ?
Nora gagne de l'___ au marché.
Je n'ai pas de ___ pour la machine.
Rosa économise son ___ pour un tracteur.
Léo rend la ___ à un client.
L'___ ne fait pas le bonheur.

sorts.why: La monnaie is change, the small coins you give back; l'argent is money in general.

quiz.prompt: Au marché, Rosa rend la ___ à Nora : deux euros cinquante. (the change)
quiz.explanation: The change you get back is la monnaie. Money in general is l'argent.
hints: Not argent: the coins given back.

quiz.prompt: Léo sells 'du raisin' at the harvest festival. What is he selling?
quiz.explanation: Le raisin is grapes. Raisins are des raisins secs, and prunes are des pruneaux.
hints: Fresh fruit, straight from the vine.

rustwake.content:
## Les faux amis à Rustwake

Out in the desert, words fool you too: the scavenger **prétend** he found a working robot (he claims it), Marta **assiste à** the market meeting (she attends it), and **la location** of a scrap armour costs ten nuts. **Actuellement**, the antenna doesn't work.

vocabulary.example: Le fouilleur prétend qu'il a trouvé un robot neuf.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The scavenger claims he found a brand-new robot.

vocabulary.example: Marta assiste à la réunion du marché.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Marta attends the market meeting.

vocabulary.example: La location d'une armure de ferraille coûte dix écrous.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Hiring a suit of scrap armour costs ten nuts.

vocabulary.example: Actuellement, l'antenne ne marche pas.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The antenna isn't working at the moment.

vocabulary.example: On pourrait éventuellement échanger ces écrous contre de l'eau.
vocabulary.example_meaning: We could possibly trade these nuts for water.

vocabulary.example: Ruiz reste dans le Dôme pendant la tempête.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Ruiz stays in the Dome during the storm.

vocabulary.example: En fait, ce soda Saphir est trop vieux.
vocabulary.example_meaning: Actually, this Saphir soda is too old.

vocabulary.example: Mon armure de ferraille est lourde.
vocabulary.example_meaning: My scrap armour is heavy.

vocabulary.example: Un écrou ne vaut pas grand-chose.
vocabulary.example_meaning: One nut isn't worth much.

vocabulary.example: La réunion commence au coucher du soleil.
vocabulary.example_meaning: The meeting starts at sunset.

bites.title: Faux amis du désert
bites.rule: Prétendre = to claim, assister à = to attend, la location = a rental. To pretend is faire semblant; to assist is aider.
bites.example: Léo prétend qu'il connaît le désert.
bites.example_meaning: Léo claims he knows the desert.

listening.text: Ruiz reste à l'atelier ce soir.
listening.meaning: Ruiz is staying at the workshop tonight.

listening.text: La location du robot est trop chère.
listening.meaning: Hiring the robot is too expensive.

listening.text: Marta a assisté à la réunion.
listening.meaning: Marta attended the meeting.

listening.text: Léo prétend qu'il a vu un scarabée géant.
listening.meaning: Léo claims he saw a giant beetle.
listening.note: New word: le scarabée = the beetle.

listening.text: Actuellement, il y a une tempête de cendres.
listening.meaning: There's an ash storm at the moment.

builds.text: Léo prétend avoir trouvé de l'eau.
builds.meaning: Léo claims to have found water.

spots.sentence: Tu peux assister Marta à porter l'eau filtrée ?
spots.why: To help someone is aider; assister à means to attend.

spots.sentence: Le marchand ne prend pas les coins, seulement les écrous.
spots.why: Coins are des pièces; un coin is a corner.

sorts.title: Assister à or attendre in the village?
sorts.why: Assister à is to attend an event; attendre is to wait for someone or something.

quiz.prompt: Léo pretends to be asleep when Ruiz comes into the workshop. Which sentence says that?
quiz.explanation: To pretend, act as if, is faire semblant de. Léo prétend dormir would mean he claims he is asleep.

quiz.prompt: Marta ___ à la réunion du marché ce soir. (to attend, présent)
quiz.explanation: To attend is assister à: Marta assiste à la réunion.
hints: Not attendre, which means to wait.
